title: Download client connection fixes
summary: Fixes long session cookies and adds a compatibility path for rdt-client's qBittorrent API.
highlights: qBittorrent-compatible clients can return session cookies up to 4,096 bytes. Jellydash keeps the full cookie when reusing the session.
A successful login without a usable session cookie now has its own error message instead of reporting rejected credentials.
Older compatible APIs, including the version advertised by rdt-client, can pass the connection test after additional checks. Choose qBittorrent and keep the client's authentication enabled.
Recent activity handles clients that return unordered history and ignore pagination, while keeping the existing response and scan limits.
